content.short: Velocimeter is a Solidly-inspired DEX on Mantle that rewards liquidity providers with option tokens (oVELO) instead of traditional inflationary emissions.
content.description: Velocimeter is a decentralized exchange based on the Solidly ve(3,3) model with a key innovation: instead of emitting native tokens directly as liquidity rewards, Velocimeter issues option tokens (oVELO) that give holders the right to purchase VELO at a discount. This mechanism dramatically reduces sell pressure while still incentivizing liquidity providers, creating a more sustainable long-term tokenomics model. Deployed on Mantle, Velocimeter is designed for LPs seeking sustainable real yield.
